params.body:
The README, read against the code. Only stale claims corrected and missing essentials added; language and structure kept. Every change with the file and line that justifies it:

# README review: abovebeyond-ai/portal

Read against a shallow clone of `main` on 2026-09-12. Line numbers refer to the clone.

## Stale, corrected

- README.md:4 "Filament voor het beheer": composer.json has no Filament package (lines 8 to 20 list every dependency); app/Http/Controllers/PortalController.php:366 says the admin screen "left with Filament". Replaced with the project settings screen at `/portal/project/{slug}/instellingen` (routes/web.php:99 to 100, owner only per PortalController.php:376).
- README.md:4 "magic link voor de toegang": passkeys exist as well (app/Http/Controllers/PasskeyController.php; routes/web.php:35 to 36 and 73 to 76; composer.json:19 `web-auth/webauthn-lib`). Added.
- README.md:4 "lokaal SQLite": the only SQLite the repo pins is the test database, `:memory:` in phpunit.xml:22 to 23. Rephrased to that.
- README.md:9 to 11 "zolang de jobs nog naar Sanity schrijven": no Sanity variable is left in .env.example (grep, none), and the ingest API is the write path (routes/api.php). The import command still exists and is still idempotent on `sanity_id` (app/Console/Commands/ImportFromSanity.php:17 to 22), so that part stays; the "jobs still write to Sanity" clause is dropped. Added `portal:import-files` (app/Console/Commands/ImportFilesFromSanity.php:23) and the session-gated file serving (app/Http/Controllers/FileController.php:9 to 12, 29).
- README.md:19 "15 minuten geldig": still true (AuthController.php:46), and the mail also says "usable once" (AuthController.php:47). Added "één keer te gebruiken".
- README.md:23 to 24 "Het beheer (`/admin`, Filament) draait voorlopig op zijn eigen login": no `/admin` route in routes/web.php; see the Filament point above. Replaced.
- README.md:28 to 33 "Wat er nog moet": every item is done in the repo. Ingest API with tokens: routes/api.php:9 to 51, .env.example `INGEST_TOKEN` and `INGEST_FABRIC_TOKEN`, app/Http/Middleware/IngestToken.php. `report.mjs` and `onboard.mjs` on Portal: .env.example comment above `INGEST_TOKEN`, IngestToken.php:17. Files local: FileController.php:29 (`Storage::disk('local')`), ImportFilesFromSanity.php. Passkeys: PasskeyController, in-app rather than as a package. Forge and DNS: elixir.json production `https://portal.abovebeyond.ai`, deploy/FORGE.md. Rewritten as a closing paragraph pointing at docs/elixir-architecture.md section "5. Open ends" (line 423).

## Missing, added

- Where it runs: elixir.json (production URL), deploy/FORGE.md (Forge, branch `main`).
- How to run and test: composer.json scripts `setup`, `dev`, `test` (lines 37 to 51); phpunit.xml SQLite in memory; Pint and PHPStan from ci.yml:38 and 43. The Vite manifest requirement comes from ci.yml:31 to 33 and elixir-fix.yml:52 to 53.
- What CI does: .github/workflows/ci.yml (push to main and pull_request; PHP 8.5 line 20, Node 22 line 29, Pint, PHPStan, tests with coverage, `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-quality@v1` lines 56 to 60); phpstan.neon level 5.
- The two Elixir workflows: .github/workflows/elixir-fix.yml (workflow_dispatch, reusable `abovebeyond-ai/elixir-fix/.github/workflows/fix.yml@v1`, header comment on why not on the box); .github/workflows/evidence.yml (`elixir/` branches, `abovebeyond-ai/control-verify-action@v1`).
- What Elixir reads: `/up` (bootstrap/app.php:17; bin/forge-sync header for the Forge health check), `/.well-known/build.json` (app/Elixir/ElixirServiceProvider.php:46, app/Elixir/BuildStamp.php), `/api/elixir` behind `ELIXIR_TOKEN` (ElixirServiceProvider.php:41, config/elixir.php:5), `elixir:beat` every minute (routes/console.php:14).
- Ingest API and the two tokens: routes/api.php, .env.example, IngestToken.php:17 to 23; `portal:fleet-snapshot` every fifteen minutes (routes/console.php:18); contract docs/fleet-brief.md.
- Webhooks and the bin scripts: routes/web.php:20 to 25 (`/webhook/nightwatch/{token}`, `/webhook/github`, `/webhook/forge/{token}`, `/webhook/deploy/{token}`); `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` and `FORGE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` in config/services.php:15 to 16; bin/register-webhooks and bin/forge-sync headers.
- Pointers to docs/elixir-architecture.md, docs/fleet-brief.md, deploy/FORGE.md.

## Left as is

- README.md:13 to 15 `data` column: true (database/migrations/2026_07_29_140000_create_portal_tables.php:30, 46, 77).
- README.md:20 `OWNER_EMAILS` and matching on contact e-mail: true (config/portal.php:11, AuthController.php:16).

## Noticed, not changed (outside the README)

- The repo root contains a tracked file literally named `.$m->invoke(null, collect($g)).PHP_EOL;\n}` whose content is a PHP "Unexpected end of input" message: a shell redirect that went wrong and got committed.
- deploy/FORGE.md is itself stale: PHP 8.4 where ci.yml pins 8.5, `make:filament-user` for a `/admin` that no longer exists, `/opt/hub-jobs/portal-token`, and "writes to Sanity and Portal".
- `.env.example` names `INGEST_TOKEN` and `INGEST_FABRIC_TOKEN` but not `OWNER_EMAILS`, `ELIXIR_TOKEN`, `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` or `FORGE_WEBHOOK_TOKEN`, all of which the code reads.

Proposed through the control gateway under #agent-workbench.
